start.title: Valley of Elah
start.text:
Two armies face each other.
Dust drifts between silent hills.

choices.feedback: You climb the ridge with your load.

flee_consequence.title: Do Not Turn Back
flee_consequence.text:
God has set your steps here.
Go to your brothers.

boast_consequence.title: Quiet Your Pride
boast_consequence.text:
Save your strength for the Lord.
Deliver what your father sent.

challenge.title: The Giant Roars
challenge.text:
"Send me a man!" Goliath shouts.
Israel's army trembles in silence.

hide_consequence.title: Stand in the Open
hide_consequence.text:
The Lord is greater than the giant.
Lift your eyes.

curse_consequence.title: Speak with Faith
curse_consequence.text:
Anger is not your weapon.
Let trust answer instead.

saul_tent.title: Saul Offers His Armor
saul_tent.text:
Heavy bronze, polished and cold.
"Wear this, boy. You will need it."

choices.feedback: It was not made for you.

choices.text: Set it aside, trust the Lord
choices.feedback: You step out lighter than air.
God has given you this hour.

armor_consequence.title: Take It Off
armor_consequence.text:
You cannot move beneath it.
God has another way.

choices.text: Set it aside, trust the Lord
choices.feedback: You let it fall to the ground.

refuse_consequence.title: Do Not Refuse
refuse_consequence.text:
The Lord delivered you from lion and bear.
He will deliver you now.

choices.text: Set it aside, trust the Lord

brook.title: Five Smooth Stones
brook.text:
Cool water runs over your feet.
The stones lie still and waiting.

choices.text: Take a sword from a soldier
choices.feedback: Your sling is enough with God.
You weigh them in your palm.

jagged_consequence.title: Choose Wisely
jagged_consequence.text:
The smooth stones fly true.
Let the brook give what God provides.

choices.feedback: You set the rough rock aside.

sword_consequence.title: Trust the Sling
sword_consequence.text:
The Lord saves not with sword or spear.
Return to the brook.

duel.title: Face to Face
duel.text:
Goliath laughs at your size.
Your sling rests against your hand.

choices.text: Match his insults with your own
choices.feedback: Speak of the Lord, not yourself.

choices.text: "I come in the name of the Lord"
choices.feedback: Your sling whirls into the wind.

pray_consequence.title: Stand and Speak
pray_consequence.text:
Faith is not silent here.
Declare the name of the Lord.

choices.text: "I come in the name of the Lord"
choices.feedback: Your voice carries across the valley.

insult_consequence.title: Honor the Lord
insult_consequence.text:
This battle belongs to God.
Let His name go before you.

choices.text: "I come in the name of the Lord"

victory.title: The Giant Falls
victory.text:
One stone, one breath, one God.
Israel's shout fills the hills.
